entries.capability: Semantic code search, symbol navigation, and focused edits
use_when: understand or change a codebase
locate symbols or references
avoid_when: the task needs only a trivial filename lookup
entries.privacy: local project context; do not send secrets

entries.capability: Recall and persist durable project decisions
use_when: prior workspace decisions can affect the task
record an explicitly requested durable checkpoint
avoid_when: simple self-contained questions
persisting sensitive data
entries.privacy: remote memory service; exclude credentials and private client content

entries.capability: Structure multi-step reasoning and revise a plan
use_when: complex task with dependencies or uncertain steps
avoid_when: simple deterministic operation
entries.privacy: tool receives reasoning context; keep sensitive data out

entries.capability: Retrieve current official library documentation
use_when: verify current framework or library APIs
avoid_when: stable general knowledge or proprietary code queries
entries.privacy: external query service; send only generic documentation queries

entries.capability: Web research with sourced answers
use_when: find current external facts and sources
avoid_when: private information or facts available from authoritative local sources
entries.privacy: external service; use public non-sensitive queries only

entries.capability: Codex built-in exec_command for bounded local shell commands
use_when: inspect files, run checks, or perform scoped local operations
avoid_when: unreviewed destructive commands or unclear targets
entries.privacy: local unless command contacts a remote service

entries.capability: Run Python test suites and focused test cases
use_when: validate Python behavior changes when the project uses pytest
avoid_when: the repository requires a different test runner

entries.capability: Run a Python unittest suite and focused cases using the repository's required command
use_when: local CI explicitly runs Python unittest
avoid_when: the repository requires pytest or another runner

entries.capability: Inspect repository changes and history
use_when: check working tree, diff, or commit provenance
avoid_when: forceful history or destructive operations without explicit scope

entries.capability: Guidance for meaningful Python tests
use_when: design tests around Python behavior and risks
avoid_when: task is not Python or test design is unnecessary

entries.capability: Review changed code for correctness and regressions
use_when: review a nontrivial implementation diff
avoid_when: no relevant diff exists

entries.capability: Systematic fault isolation and debugging
use_when: reproduce and isolate a failure
avoid_when: no failure or diagnostic question exists

entries.capability: Inspect browser behavior with developer tools
use_when: diagnose a browser-only defect
avoid_when: non-browser task
Chrome DevTools MCP is not active in this session

entries.capability: Review API contract and boundary design
use_when: design or review an API boundary
avoid_when: no API design decision is involved

entries.capability: Derive security requirements from a system description
use_when: identify concrete security requirements
avoid_when: ordinary change has no security impact
entries.privacy: local skill metadata; redact sensitive system details

entries.capability: Create an implementation plan grounded in repository context
use_when: a scoped task needs a sequenced implementation plan
avoid_when: the request is a simple direct change or plan authoring was not requested

entries.capability: Plan and validate Kubernetes GitOps changes
use_when: a Kubernetes change follows an existing GitOps workflow
avoid_when: the task is unrelated to Kubernetes or would bypass deployment approval
entries.privacy: local skill metadata; cluster details may be sensitive

entries.capability: Create or adjust Helm chart structure
use_when: a task explicitly requires a new Helm chart scaffold
avoid_when: an existing chart can meet the need or deployment is out of scope
entries.privacy: local skill metadata; cluster details may be sensitive

entries.capability: Create or inspect structured office documents
use_when: produce or validate DOCX/PDF deliverables
avoid_when: no document artifact is needed
entries.privacy: document contents may be sensitive; keep local unless approved

entries.capability: Build and distribute a Python package with modern project metadata
use_when: create, package, or release a Python distribution
avoid_when: the project does not use Python packaging

entries.capability: Official OpenAI documentation for Codex models, Desktop and CLI, hooks, settings, skills, setup, and troubleshooting
use_when: document or troubleshoot Codex Desktop/CLI behavior, hooks, settings, skills, models, or setup
verify current official OpenAI product or API guidance when the task is specifically about Codex or OpenAI
avoid_when: generic Python or web coding that only mentions Codex
unrelated software documentation or implementation
entries.privacy: local stock skill metadata; send only allowlisted task metadata and generic candidate descriptions

entries.capability: Choose focused tests after a change and complete required repository validation
use_when: a code change needs targeted regression tests
select focused checks before required suite gates
avoid_when: the task does not change testable behavior and no repository gate applies

entries.capability: Review a diff, affected callers, contracts, and failure paths for regressions
use_when: review a nontrivial code diff for correctness risks
trace changed behavior through callers and contracts
avoid_when: no relevant diff exists
the task only asks for test execution without a code review
